Smart BM3 Bronze 750W ATX 3.1 - TT Premium Edition
 – Thermaltake Global
Smart BM3 Bronze 750W ATX 3.1 - TT Premium Edition
Smart BM3 Bronze 750W ATX 3.1 - TT Premium Edition
80 PLUS Bronze certified semi modular PSU, compatible with ATX 3.1 specifications. Designed with a native PCIe Gen 5.1 connector, it can power up next-gen entry level GPUs with one 12+4pin cable.
Power Up the Next Generation Hardware

Smart BM3 (550W/650W/750W/850W) 80 PLUS Bronze certified semi modular PSU is designed to meet ATX 3.1 standards, it also comes with one PCIe Gen 5.1 (12V-2x6) connector to support modern graphics cards. With an ample 5-year warranty, the Smart BM3 series is able to satisfy the market, where value-oriented users are looking for a new power supply with all the latest features.

Smart BM3 series is fully compatible with ATX 3.1 Specifications which supports up to 200% power excursion, reaches 60% efficiency at low load and complies with required power supply timing standards.
Smart BM3 Bronze series comes with a PCIe 12V-2x6 connector to offer powerful and stable performance allowing the PSU to natively run next-generation GPUs.
The wattage marked on the PCIe 12+4pin cable connector is the recommended wattage. (Ref. Intel design guideline)
The native 12+4pin (12V-2x6) PCIe connector of the Smart BM3 550W can deliver up to 300W for PCIe 12+4pin graphics cards.
1. Recommended wattage is an estimation of system power demand. Actual power demands may vary based on specific components, usage, and many other factors.
2. Please follow the recommended power requirements from the GPU manufactures before using the 12+4pin cable.
Made to Comply with the Latest Graphics Cards

Ready to supply graphics cards according to their different ways of connections, the Smart BM3 series is designed to support NVIDIA and AMD graphics cards, it supports 8-pin PCIe cable for AMD graphics cards & entry RTX 40 series graphics cards, it also comes with 1 x 12+4pin connector for RTX 40 series cards that need a PCIe Gen 5.1 connector, ready to supply the graphics cards according to their different ways of connections.
Featuring a 120mm FDB fan to deliver excellent airflow. Furthermore, with the Smart Zero Fan function the fan will not spin until the load reaches a certain percentage to minimize unwanted noise.
High quality Japanese main capacitor greatly improves the power supplies durability and ensures the Smart BM3 series is stable and reliable.
High Amperage Single +12V Rail & DC to DC Design
Powerful single +12V rail can properly deliver the power you need for the best compatibility. The use of DC to DC circuit design provides very stable operation and enhanced voltage regulation.

To protect the hardware, Smart BM3 is built with industry grade protections: OCP(Over Current Protection), OVP (Over Voltage Protection), UVP(Under Voltage Protection), OPP(Over Power Protection), SCP(Short Circuit Protection), OTP(Over Temperature Protection).
Soft flat black cables come with sleeve cabling, designed to make cable installation an easy task while fully powering the system at optimal voltages.
80 PLUS Bronze-Certified and Intel C6/C7 States Ready

Smart BM3 Bronze series saves energy through its high energy efficiency up to 85% and is certified to 80 PLUS® Bronze. It has been optimized to work with all generations of Intel’s processors to achieve maximum energy saving.
